paragraphs: Tybera Development Group is a Utah-based company that provides electronic filing, case management and document management software for attorneys, courts and government agencies. The about page says the company was founded in 2001 and supports all court types and all filing types. Its technology may be acquired by license, subscription, or per transaction.

The eFlex filing system consists of two modules, the Filer Interface or Electronic Filing Service Provider, and the Review Interface or the E-Filing Manager. Alpine is a browser-based case management system that handles cases, parties, events and calendaring across the lifecycle of a case. CEDAR is document archiving and storage technology designed to fit the needs of courts and government agencies. It maintains index information about where documents are stored in relation to the case and for revision control.

The homepage says support is provided to customers, with a link to get product support. News headlines on that page name Cumberland County Courts and Fort Bragg as partners offering a domestic violence eFiling system. Another headline says Tybera Development Group achieved SOC 2 Type II compliance.
